briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 push reasoning benchmarks past 95% amid escalating US-China compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple reasoning-focused models this month with o4 and R2 leading. Funding remains robust while regulatory pressure on export controls intensifies. Prompt injection and multi-agent coordination risks continue to dominate security discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4 with 2.1T parameters achieving 96% on GPQA. Anthropic Claude 4 Opus and DeepSeek R2 both launched within 72 hours. Meta's Llama 4.1 and xAI Grok-3.5 entered public preview.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. CISA issued new guidance on agentic workflow risks while EU AI Act enforcement begins phase two.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments reaching 500k units monthly. Microsoft and Google each broke ground on 3GW AI campuses in Texas and Arizona respectively.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like DialectForge become mandatory infrastructure before the first 10^27 FLOP training run?
